acceptanceRequirements.evidence: The founder's Google action entered MoolSocial Social Home. The runtime then emitted ready with authenticated=true; the release state machine cannot enter authenticated ready without an accepted Firebase user/session.
A non-private force-stop and cold relaunch restored ready with authenticated=true and did not return to unauthenticated sign-in.
Founder-observed navigation reached the authenticated Social Home; sanitized runtime state independently reported authenticated=true.
Real OPPO flow reached authenticated MoolSocial state and retained it across a cold relaunch with zero fatal errors or ANRs.

youtubeDisposition.finding: Google Firebase authentication does not automatically authorize YouTube API/channel access. The Google-only r60.87 runtime intentionally keeps YouTube provider inputs disabled and fail-closed.
